spriteComponent.name: blackout
spriteComponent.event:
component("spriteName"):SetString("__BUILTIN__WHITE_TEXTURE") local palette = include("ColourPalette") component:setColor(palette:getRGBFloats(palette.LOAD_FADE_COLOUR)) component("alpha"):SetFloat(0.0) component:setScale(Vector2(lua_sys.screenWidth()*0.25, lua_sys.screenHeight()*0.25)) component("layer"):SetString("Loading")
local FadeTransition = include("FadeTransition") component.FadeTransition = FadeTransition:new({ duration = 0.6, maxFade = 0.1, ease = lua_sys.Linear_EaseNone, onUpdate = function(alpha) component:GetVar("alpha"):SetFloat(alpha) end }) component.FadeTransition:Show()
